frontmatter.title: Eliminating Rework in Software: A Lean Six Sigma Guide to First-Time Quality
frontmatter.subheading: Stop paying the “rework tax” with clearer requirements, better slicing, and tighter feedback loops.
frontmatter.excerpt: Reduce rework in software engineering using Lean Six Sigma: identify rework hotspots, quantify their cost, use root-cause analysis, and implement controls that improve first-time quality.
frontmatter.author: Paul Serban
